stribElex.anchorContract: All election-result layers insert with beforeId "water". Every layer BELOW that anchor must resolve to flat #f7f7f7 so a precinct's rendered color depends only on its margin.

acceptedColorCollisions.whyAccepted: Separates by hue, not lightness: the "gray" bucket is a saturated candidate hue, and the casing is strictly achromatic. Also sits in the achromatic L* 88-90 gap that no near-neutral locked result color occupies.
Separates by a deliberate warm hue shift plus a 0.4 fill-opacity cap, so footprints read as texture rather than as a data value. Buildings also only exist z13-14.

stribElex.collisionTestLimitation: The verification script compares L* only, so it cannot see hue or opacity separation and will keep reporting both entries above.
